description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionDeleted event class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.connectivity package. It models an event emitted after a Connection object has been deleted, providing methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and includes metadata such as event name and type.

classes.name: ConnectionDeleted
classes.description: A final, immutable class representing a 'connectionDeleted' event, emitted after a Connection has been deleted. Extends AbstractConnectivityEvent and implements ConnectivityEvent, providing static factory methods, JSON deserialization, and payload handling.

methods.name: ConnectionDeleted.of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionDeleted event with connection ID, optional timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: ConnectionDeleted.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionDeleted event instance from a JSON string or object, with associated headers.
